criteria.observation: The fixed adapter reports each explicitly saved boolean as that checkbox’s initial checked value.
Absent or invalid fields use their own documented defaults, including when the other field is explicitly set.
Initialization returns fresh state with the documented fields and preserves saved input, previous results and shared defaults.
A subsequent update and reset preserve other settings and the original checkbox contract.
The submitted report matches an actual check through initialization, display projection and later operations, within the adapter’s observable scope.
